profile.about: I'm Erudita, a full-stack developer and UI/UX designer building software where engineering precision meets exceptional design. From AI-powered platforms and complex operational dashboards to mobile apps and production websites for real businesses, I turn ambitious ideas into polished digital products that are built to work, built to scale, and built to stand out. My experience spans 20+ projects, international hackathons, competition-winning work, and client projects across borders, but my standard remains the same: make it functional, make it exceptional, and never make it ordinary.
profile.availabilityText: Available for 3 new client projects this month

projects.title: Chanel E-Commerce Concept
projects.description: Chanel E-Commerce Concept is a luxury shopping website created with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to demonstrate my front-end e-commerce skills. The project recreates a premium fashion retail experience through elegant product presentation, category browsing, interactive product details, shopping cart functionality, responsive layouts, and refined visual design.
projects.problem: Luxury e-commerce websites must balance strong brand presentation with clear navigation, responsive product discovery, and a smooth shopping journey without making the interface feel crowded or generic.
projects.solution: Designed and developed a responsive luxury storefront featuring curated product collections, category navigation, interactive product cards, product detail views, cart interactions, polished animations, and a premium visual system inspired by high-end fashion commerce.
projects.results: Created a complete front-end shopping experience that demonstrates e-commerce interface design, responsive development, JavaScript interaction, product organization, cart logic, and attention to luxury branding.
projects.projectRole: Designed and developed the complete front-end experience, including UI/UX, responsive layouts, product collections, category navigation, product interactions, shopping cart functionality, animations, testing, and cross-device optimization.
projects.technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Local Storage, Responsive Design

projects.title: Netflix Clone
projects.description: Netflix Clone is a full-stack streaming platform inspired by the Netflix experience. It features user authentication, movie browsing, categorized content, search functionality, responsive design, and a backend-powered content management system. The project focuses on recreating a modern streaming interface while demonstrating full-stack web development fundamentals.
projects.problem: Building a modern streaming platform requires combining responsive frontend development with secure user authentication, dynamic content management, and database integration while maintaining a familiar, intuitive user experience.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack web application featuring secure authentication, dynamic movie listings, category organization, search functionality, responsive layouts, and a PHP/MySQL backend for managing users and content.
projects.results: Successfully recreated the core Netflix browsing experience while demonstrating full-stack development, responsive UI design, backend integration, database management, and user authentication.
projects.projectRole: Designed and developed the complete application, including UI/UX, responsive frontend, PHP backend, MySQL database, authentication system, movie management, search functionality, testing, and deployment preparation.

projects.title: Expense Tracker
projects.description: Expense Tracker is a React Native personal finance application that helps users manage income, expenses, budgets, and financial goals in one intuitive mobile experience. It provides real-time spending insights, categorized transactions, visual analytics, and secure account management to simplify everyday budgeting.
projects.problem: Many users struggle to monitor daily spending, organize transactions, and understand their financial habits due to fragmented or overly complex budgeting tools.
projects.solution: Developed a mobile finance platform that centralizes income and expense tracking, spending categories, budget management, financial analytics, and transaction history into a fast, user-friendly React Native application.
projects.results: Delivered a modern expense management app that helps users track finances more efficiently, monitor budgets, understand spending habits through analytics, and make better financial decisions.
projects.projectRole: Led the complete mobile application development, including UI/UX design, React Native architecture, Node.js backend, PostgreSQL database design, authentication, transaction management, analytics, API development, testing, and deployment preparation.
projects.technologies: React Native, JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, JWT Authentication

projects.title: NutriFlow
projects.description: NutriFlow is a React Native nutrition and wellness application that helps users build healthier eating habits through personalized meal planning, nutrition tracking, calorie and macro monitoring, progress analytics, and health insights. The platform combines an intuitive mobile experience with a scalable backend to simplify daily nutrition management.
projects.problem: Many nutrition apps are difficult to use, requiring users to switch between multiple tools for meal planning, calorie tracking, progress monitoring, and health goals.
projects.solution: Developed a mobile nutrition platform that centralizes meal planning, food tracking, calorie and macronutrient monitoring, health goals, progress analytics, and personalized recommendations into one seamless React Native application.
projects.results: Delivered a modern nutrition app that simplifies healthy eating, helps users stay consistent with their goals, improves progress visibility, and provides an intuitive mobile-first experience.
projects.projectRole: Led the complete mobile application development, including UI/UX design, React Native architecture, Node.js backend, PostgreSQL database design, authentication, nutrition tracking, analytics, API development, testing, and deployment preparation.
projects.technologies: React Native, JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, JWT Authentication

projects.title: MindFlow OS
projects.description: MindFlow OS is a React Native productivity application designed to help users organize tasks, projects, goals, notes, and daily routines in one intuitive mobile experience. It combines smart planning, progress tracking, calendar scheduling, focus sessions, and productivity insights to improve organization and daily workflow.
projects.problem: Users often rely on multiple apps for tasks, notes, goals, and schedules, making it difficult to stay organized, maintain focus, and track progress efficiently.
projects.solution: Developed a mobile productivity platform that unifies task management, project organization, goal tracking, calendar scheduling, notes, focus sessions, and productivity analytics into a single, user-friendly React Native application.
projects.results: Delivered an all-in-one mobile workspace that simplifies planning, improves productivity, centralizes personal organization, and helps users manage their daily activities more efficiently.
projects.projectRole: Led the complete mobile application development, including UI/UX design, React Native architecture, Node.js backend, PostgreSQL database design, authentication, task workflows, calendar features, analytics, testing, and deployment preparation.
projects.technologies: React Native, JavaScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API, JWT Authentication

projects.title: Pyramid Backstage
projects.description: A full-stack event operations platform built during JunctionX Tirana 2026, consisting of a web-based admin dashboard and a React Native mobile application for staff. The platform centralizes event planning, space allocation, scheduling, equipment reservations, proposals, task management, staff coordination, and operational readiness. It features AI-assisted event planning, a real-time Digital Twin, automatic conflict detection, Kanban-based workflows, analytics, readiness scoring, live notifications, digital checklists, and real-time synchronization between administrators and on-site teams to ensure seamless event execution.
projects.technologies: React, React Native, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, PostgreSQL, TanStack Router, Framer Motion, Node.js, REST API, Lucide React
projects.problem: Managing large-scale venue operations with disconnected tools made event planning, staff coordination, scheduling, and resource management inefficient. Teams lacked real-time visibility, causing scheduling conflicts, communication delays, and reduced operational readiness during live events.
projects.solution: Designed and developed a full-stack event operations platform consisting of a web-based admin dashboard and a React Native staff mobile app. The system includes AI-assisted event planning, Digital Twin visualization, scheduling, equipment reservations, proposal generation, Kanban task management, readiness scoring, live notifications, and real-time synchronization between administrators and staff.
projects.results: Delivered a unified platform that streamlined event operations, reduced manual coordination, improved scheduling accuracy, increased team visibility, enabled faster decision-making, and provided a scalable foundation for managing complex venues with real-time collaboration.
projects.projectRole: Led the end-to-end development of the platform, including UI/UX design, React web app, React Native mobile app, Supabase backend, database architecture, authentication, AI features, real-time synchronization, testing, and deployment preparation.

projects.title: Pizzeria Paradiso
projects.description: A premium restaurant website developed for Pizzeria Paradiso in Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Designed to showcase the brand, menu, and dining experience while providing seamless table reservations, online ordering, takeaway, and delivery. Built with a mobile-first approach, fast performance, responsive design, and SEO optimization to maximize user experience and online visibility.
projects.headline: Fresh. Authentic. Italian.
projects.problem: The restaurant lacked a modern digital presence that clearly showcased its menu, brand, and services while making reservations and online ordering quick and intuitive across all devices.
projects.solution: Designed and developed a high-performance, mobile-first restaurant website with an immersive visual experience, streamlined navigation, online reservations, menu browsing, SEO optimization, and fast loading for an excellent user experience.
projects.results: Delivered a premium digital experience that improved online visibility, simplified reservations and ordering, strengthened the restaurant's brand, and provided customers with a fast, responsive experience on every device.
projects.timeline: 3-day production sprint from structure to polished launch.
projects.projectRole: Led the complete website redesign and development, including UI/UX design, frontend architecture, responsive implementation, menu experience, reservation flow, SEO optimization, performance improvements, deployment, and client collaboration.
projects.technologies: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Responsive Design, SEO, PHP, MySQL

projects.title: SciMaster AI — Intelligent STEM Learning Platform
projects.description: SciMaster AI is a full-stack learning platform designed to help students understand mathematics, biology, IT, and programming through interactive tools and AI-assisted explanations. It includes a step-by-step mathematics solver with visual graphs, biology theory, flashcards, quizzes, recall sessions, coding challenges, a browser-based coding playground, progress tracking, and a personalized student dashboard.
projects.headline: Study smarter with AI.
projects.problem: Students often use separate tools for solving mathematics problems, viewing graphs, studying theory, practising recall, and learning code. This creates a disconnected experience and makes it difficult to understand complex topics or track progress effectively.
projects.solution: I developed a unified student platform combining step-by-step mathematics solutions, interactive function graphs, biology lessons, flashcards, quizzes, coding challenges, and an in-browser coding playground. A personalized dashboard organizes subjects, learning activity, and progress in one accessible experience.
projects.results: SciMaster AI created a more structured and interactive learning workflow where students can move from theory to practice, receive guided explanations, visualize mathematical solutions, test their knowledge, practise programming, and monitor progress from one platform.
techDecisions: React for the interactive student interface
Vite for fast development and optimized builds
Tailwind CSS for responsive UI styling
Flask and Python for mathematics-solving services
Node.js for application services and APIs
Interactive graph rendering for mathematical functions
Modular architecture for expanding learning categories
projects.timeline: Concept sprint for AI flow, dashboards and learning states.
projects.projectRole: Led the complete platform development, including UI/UX design, React frontend, Flask and Node.js services, AI-assisted explanations, mathematics solver, graph visualization, learning modules, coding playground, progress dashboard, testing, and deployment.
projects.technologies: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Python, Flask, Node.js, REST API, AI Integration, Graph Visualization, Code Editor
